purpose: Repository-safe authoritative MODEL-05 prospective-validation preregistration for later PIPE target-blind freeze consumption; this artifact is not a prediction package or target-opening authorization.

aggregation.contribution: each selected tract contributes its entire accepted tract estimate exactly once

household_opportunity.primary_quantity: H_i(r) = sum of B11001_001E across selected whole tracts

ranking_and_level.materiality_interpretation: practical directional margin, not a conventional significance threshold
ranking_and_level.descriptive_mapping: predicted weekly sales = kappa × household opportunity
ranking_and_level.kappa_derivation: development-derived from the accepted consumed development cohort under the frozen MODEL-05 rule

inconclusive: primary materiality met but a frozen robustness check reverses sign

geometric_completeness.primary_rule: C >= 0.90 is eligible for primary statistics
geometric_completeness.secondary_rule: 0.75 <= C < 0.90 is excluded from primary and retained as labeled secondary truncated-stratum evidence
geometric_completeness.qa_only_rule: C < 0.75 is QA only and excluded from quantitative validation

dependence.grouping: undirected threshold graph with transitive connected components

validation.stage_progression: Each later stage remains sealed until explicit MODEL disposition of the prior stage; success never automatically authorizes the next stage.

milwaukee_temporal_gate.purpose: target/revision stability at repeated physical locations, not independent new-location prediction
milwaukee_temporal_gate.primary_metric: Kendall tau-b between most recent prior-vintage Isolated Sales and 2026 Isolated Sales

milwaukee_prospective.rules: global prospective ranking, materiality, and robustness rules

madison_historical_external_gate.purpose: external temporal stability and directional transport screening
madison_historical_external_gate.unit: one resolved physical location paired by vintage
madison_historical_external_gate.primary_metric: Kendall tau-b between 2024 and 2025 Isolated Sales ranks
fail: household tau is nonpositive in both vintages

madison_2026_external_new_location.identity_requirement: genuinely new under accepted MODEL-04 package
madison_2026_external_new_location.primary: within-cohort Kendall tau-b under global prospective success/failure/inconclusive rule

target_governance.consumption_rule: A cohort whose target influences any later feature, transformation, coefficient, model, radius, aggregation, metric, threshold, exception, or business rule becomes consumed for that revised version and cannot silently regain untouched status.

content_hash_semantics: SHA-256 of canonical UTF-8 JSON after removing content_sha256: recursively sorted object keys, compact separators, Unicode preserved, no NaN. Materialization timestamps are excluded from semantic content.
supersession_policy: Never overwrite this immutable preregistration. A correction creates a versioned successor with explicit supersedes lineage and a newly calculated content_sha256.
failure_behavior: Fail closed on identity, version, content hash, dependency, frozen-parameter, stage, target-state, or no-rescue mismatch. Local configuration cannot override accepted values.
